label: Eliminating a variable by resolution
subgoals: Split the clauses into those with x and those with its negation
Resolve every positive clause with every negative clause on x
Drop tautologies and count the remaining resolvents

label: When elimination pays
subgoals: Subtract the number of clauses that contain x or its negation
Eliminate only when the change is zero or negative

label: Subsumption
subgoals: Test each clause for being a superset of another clause
Mark every clause that is a superset as deletable
